name: Grand Hyatt Indian Wells Resort & Villas
insider_take: Desert luxury meets world-class golf in the heart of the Coachella Valley, where celebrity sightings are as common as perfect weather.
whats_special: This sprawling resort sits on 45 acres adjacent to the Indian Wells Golf Resort, home to the BNP Paribas Open tennis tournament. The property features the largest resort spa in the desert and boasts seven pools, including an adults-only rooftop pool with stunning mountain views. Indian Wells is known as the "City of Festivals" and maintains one of the lowest crime rates in California.
pro_tip: Book during March for the BNP Paribas Open when A-listers flock to the desert, or visit in late spring for perfect poolside weather without the tournament crowds.
dont_miss: The resort's championship golf courses designed by Clive Clark, the subterranean Agua Serena Spa with its co-ed relaxation pool, and sunset cocktails at the rooftop bar overlooking the Santa Rosa Mountains. The nearby Living Desert Zoo showcases native desert wildlife and botanical gardens.
pros: Spectacular multi-pool complex with lazy river, waterslides, and swim-up bar perfect for all ages
Breathtaking panoramic views of the Santa Rosa Mountains and Coachella Valley desert landscape
World-class Agua Serena Spa offering rejuvenating desert-inspired treatments and wellness experiences
Spacious villas and suites ideal for families, groups, and extended luxury stays
Exceptional on-site dining with multiple restaurants showcasing fresh, locally inspired Californian cuisine
cons: Secluded desert location requires a car or transport to reach Palm Springs dining and nightlife
Daily resort fee applies on top of room rate, adding to overall trip cost
